sql: SELECT (AVG(CASE WHEN i.invoice_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' AND i.invoice_date<DATE '2026-01-01' THEN i.total END)-AVG(CASE WHEN i.invoice_date>=DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date<DATE '2025-01-01' THEN i.total END))/NULLIF(AVG(CASE WHEN i.invoice_date>=DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date<DATE '2025-01-01' THEN i.total END),0) AS value FROM public.invoice i WHERE i.billing_country='Germany'
